exclusions.A: This spring, at seventy-eight, she stepped down as keeper, and the idea of a sensor was her own.
exclusions.B: Neve brought her class to watch that last reading, the last time anyone would cross the lawn to the box.
exclusions.C: The council's chair said the vote rested on a single point: for a month, the machine's figures had matched Ida's to the tenth of a degree.
exclusions.D: Then the book was shut and carried to the archive, where the rest of its final page stays empty under Ida's last figure.

WV9-P01.5.note: The closing images (the last reading, the empty final page, the latched box the children walk past) are elegiac, so wistful fits best, though the forty-one unbroken years could support admiring; the D exclusion is weak, since it shows the closing emphasis falls on loss rather than praise without ruling admiration out.
